Code developed by author with assistance from Claude (Sonnet 4.6). Output checked and validated by author.

> **Scope:** This script analyses only compounds flagged as `environmental_exposure` in
> `Newbatch2_Exogenous_Flagging.Rmd` that can be classified as pharmaceutical medications.
> Dietary stimulants (caffeine, theobromine), pesticides, and preservatives (parabens) that
> share the `environmental_exposure` flag are excluded here.
>
> **Statistical note:** With a small compound set, FDR correction is less conservative than
> in the full untargeted analysis. Results should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating
> given the low expected N of detected medications.

# Set Up

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

Packages <- c(
  "readxl", "stats", "ggfortify", "ggrepel", "svglite", "Biobase",
  "ComplexHeatmap", "limma", "tidyverse", "cowplot", "UpSetR"
)

lapply(Packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r source_functions, include=FALSE}
source("functions.R")
source("missingness_visualization_functions.R")
```

```{r set_paths, include=FALSE}
png_path <- "../../results/untargeted/newbatch2_medications"
svg_path <- "../../results/untargeted/newbatch2_medications/svg"
csv_path <- "../../results/untargeted/newbatch2_medications/csv"
dir.create(png_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(svg_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(csv_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load Dataset(s)

```{r LoadDataset, include=FALSE}
newbatch2_peak_area           <- read_csv("../../results/untargeted/newbatch2_peak_area_values.csv",
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)
# Use the flagged annotation file — this is required to access Exogenous_Flag
newbatch2_compound_annotation <- read_csv("../../results/untargeted/newbatch2_metabolite_annotations_flagged.csv",
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)
newbatch2_sample_metadata     <- read_csv("../../results/untargeted/newbatch2_sample_metadata.csv",
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Compounds loaded:", nrow(newbatch2_peak_area), "\n")
cat("Annotations loaded:", nrow(newbatch2_compound_annotation), "\n")
```

## Build Full ExpressionSet

```{r prep_dataframe}
final_matrix <- newbatch2_peak_area %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Sample"))

compounds_in_peak <- unique(newbatch2_peak_area$Compound.ID)

newbatch2_compound_annotation <- newbatch2_compound_annotation %>%
  filter(Compound.ID %in% compounds_in_peak) %>%
  arrange(match(Name, rownames(final_matrix)))

metabolite_names <- newbatch2_compound_annotation$Name
final_matrix <- apply(final_matrix, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(final_matrix) <- metabolite_names

newbatch2_sample_metadata <- newbatch2_sample_metadata %>%
  filter(Sample %in% colnames(final_matrix)) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, colnames(final_matrix)))

sample_metadata_df <- as.data.frame(newbatch2_sample_metadata)
rownames(sample_metadata_df) <- sample_metadata_df$Sample
sample_phenoData <- AnnotatedDataFrame(sample_metadata_df)

metabolite_metadata_df <- as.data.frame(newbatch2_compound_annotation)
rownames(metabolite_metadata_df) <- metabolite_metadata_df$Name
metabolite_featureData <- AnnotatedDataFrame(metabolite_metadata_df)

newbatch2_metabolomics <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = final_matrix,
  phenoData = sample_phenoData,
  featureData = metabolite_featureData
)
```

```{r log_transform}
exprs(newbatch2_metabolomics) <- log2(exprs(newbatch2_metabolomics) + 1)
cat("Log2 transformation applied.\n")
cat("Intensity range after:", range(exprs(newbatch2_metabolomics), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

---

# Define Medication Subgroup

Drug class is assigned by name-pattern matching. Compounds flagged as `environmental_exposure`
that do not match any pharmaceutical class (i.e., pesticides, dietary stimulants, parabens)
are excluded.

```{r assign_drug_class}
# Drug class assignment function — operates on lowercase compound names.
# Returns NA for non-medication environmental exposures (pesticides, caffeine, parabens).
# Intentionally excludes levothyroxine/thyroxine (identical to endogenous T4)
# and progesterone (endogenous and biologically critical in fetal brain).
assign_drug_class <- function(name) {
  n <- tolower(name)
  dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(n, paste(
      "norgestrel", "levonorgestrel", "medroxyprogesterone", "megestrol",
      "norethindrone", "gestodene", "desogestrel", "etonogestrel",
      "methasterone", "nandrolone", "stanozolol", "trenbolone",
      "boldenone", "oxandrolone", "methandrostenolone",
      "ethinylestradiol", "diethylstilbestrol", "\\bdes\\b",
      "tamoxifen", "clomiphene",
      sep = "|"
    )) ~ "Synthetic hormone",
    str_detect(n, paste(
      "betamethasone", "dexamethasone", "\\bprednisone\\b", "prednisolone",
      sep = "|"
    )) ~ "Synthetic glucocorticoid",
    str_detect(n, paste(
      "ibuprofen", "naproxen", "acetaminophen", "paracetamol",
      "\\baspirin\\b", "acetylsalicyl",
      sep = "|"
    )) ~ "NSAID / Analgesic",
    str_detect(n, paste(
      "metformin", "atorvastatin", "simvastatin", "lovastatin",
      "lisinopril", "amlodipine", "metoprolol",
      "labetalol", "hydralazine", "nifedipine", "methyldopa", "minoxidil",
      sep = "|"
    )) ~ "Cardiovascular / Metabolic",
    str_detect(n, paste(
      "fluoxetine", "sertraline", "paroxetine", "venlafaxine",
      "lorazepam", "diazepam", "alprazolam",
      "lamotrigine", "valproic", "\\bvalproate\\b", "valproex",
      sep = "|"
    )) ~ "CNS",
    str_detect(n, paste(
      "amoxicillin", "azithromycin", "doxycycline",
      sep = "|"
    )) ~ "Antibiotic",
    str_detect(n, "ondansetron") ~ "Antiemetic",
    str_detect(n, "diphenhydramine") ~ "Antihistamine",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  # pesticides, caffeine, parabens — excluded
  )
}
```

```{r define_medication_subgroup}
annotation_full <- fData(newbatch2_metabolomics)

medication_annotation <- annotation_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(Exogenous_Flag) & Exogenous_Flag == "environmental_exposure") %>%
  mutate(Drug_Class = assign_drug_class(Name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Drug_Class))  # removes pesticides, caffeine, parabens

cat("=== Medication Subgroup ===\n")
cat("Environmental exposures flagged:", sum(!is.na(annotation_full$Exogenous_Flag) &
      annotation_full$Exogenous_Flag == "environmental_exposure"), "\n")
cat("Classified as medications:", nrow(medication_annotation), "\n\n")

cat("--- Detected medications by drug class ---\n")
medication_annotation %>%
  dplyr::select(Name, Drug_Class, Class, Annotation_Confidence) %>%
  arrange(Drug_Class, Name) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r build_medication_eset}
medication_names <- medication_annotation$Name

if (length(medication_names) == 0) {
  stop("No medications detected in peak area data. Check that newbatch2_Exogenous_Flagging.Rmd has been run and the flagged CSV is up to date.")
}

# Subset ExpressionSet to medication compounds only
idx <- featureNames(newbatch2_metabolomics) %in% medication_names
eset_med <- newbatch2_metabolomics[idx, ]

# Store drug class in featureData for downstream use
fData(eset_med) <- fData(eset_med) %>%
  mutate(Drug_Class = assign_drug_class(Name))

cat("Medication ExpressionSet:", nrow(eset_med), "features x", ncol(eset_med), "samples\n")
```

# Statistical Analyses

```{r extract_metadata}
metadata_loop <- pData(eset_med)
GW         <- metadata_loop$GW
sex_groups <- factor(metadata_loop$Sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
n_features <- nrow(eset_med)

cat("N compounds:", n_features, "\n")
cat("N samples:", ncol(eset_med), "\n")
cat("Sex distribution:", table(sex_groups), "\n")
cat("GW range:", range(GW, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## GW — limma

Continuous linear model `~ GW` matching the approach in the full untargeted analysis.

```{r gw_limma}
design_gw <- model.matrix(~ GW, data = metadata_loop)
fit_gw    <- lmFit(exprs(eset_med), design_gw)
fit_gw    <- eBayes(fit_gw)

gw_limma_results <- topTable(fit_gw, coef = "GW", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  rownames_to_column("Name") %>%
  left_join(
    fData(eset_med) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Drug_Class, Class),
    by = "Name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Increases with GW", "Decreases with GW"),
    FDR_label = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adj.P.Val < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE              ~ ""
    )
  )

cat("GW limma — nominal p < 0.05:", sum(gw_limma_results$P.Value < 0.05), "\n")
cat("GW limma — FDR < 0.05:", sum(gw_limma_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")

gw_limma_results %>%
  arrange(P.Value) %>%
  dplyr::select(Name, Drug_Class, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "GW limma results — all medications") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

write_csv(gw_limma_results, file.path(csv_path, "newbatch2_medication_gw_limma.csv"))
```

```{r gw_limma_bar, fig.show='hide'}
gw_bar_data <- gw_limma_results %>%
  arrange(P.Value) %>%
  mutate(Name_display = truncate_labels(Name))

n_bar <- nrow(gw_bar_data)
bar_height <- max(5, 0.4 * n_bar)

gw_bar <- ggplot(gw_bar_data,
    aes(x = reorder(Name, logFC), y = logFC, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = FDR_label, hjust = ifelse(logFC > 0, -0.2, 1.2)),
    size = 4, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(gw_bar_data$Name_display, gw_bar_data$Name)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Increases with GW" = "steelblue",
    "Decreases with GW" = "tomato"
  )) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Drug_Class), scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Compound",
    y = "Slope (log2 peak area per GW week)",
    title = "GW-Associated Medications — limma",
    caption = "* FDR < 0.05   ** FDR < 0.01   *** FDR < 0.001\nFacets = drug class"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
  )

save_dual_format(gw_bar, "gw_limma_bar_medications",
  png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
  width = 10, height = bar_height,
  label_lookup = build_label_lookup(gw_bar_data$Name)
)
```

```{r gw_limma_bar_print, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(png_path, "gw_limma_bar_medications.png"))
```

```{r gw_limma_trajectories}
gw_nominal_names <- gw_limma_results %>%
  filter(P.Value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Name)

cat("GW limma nominal p < 0.05:", length(gw_nominal_names), "compound(s)\n")

if (length(gw_nominal_names) > 0) {
  gw_traj_suffixes <- gw_limma_results %>%
    filter(Name %in% gw_nominal_names) %>%
    arrange(match(Name, gw_nominal_names)) %>%
    mutate(suffix = sprintf("logFC=%.2f | p=%.3f | FDR=%.3f", logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)) %>%
    pull(suffix)
  gw_traj_plots <- build_trajectory_plots(gw_nominal_names, eset_med, title_suffixes = gw_traj_suffixes)
  save_trajectory_grids(gw_traj_plots, "gw_limma_trajectories",
    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
} else {
  cat("No GW limma nominal hits — skipping trajectories.\n")
}
```

## Sex — limma

```{r sex_limma}
metadata_limma      <- pData(eset_med)
metadata_limma$Sex  <- factor(metadata_limma$Sex, levels = c("F", "M"))

fit_sex <- lmFit(exprs(eset_med), design_sex)
fit_sex <- eBayes(fit_sex)
```

## Sex — Wilcoxon

Non-parametric complement to limma. Useful given potentially non-normal distributions of
exogenous compounds.

```{r sex_wilcoxon}
wilcoxon_test <- function(x, sex) {
  valid_idx <- !is.na(x)
  x_clean   <- x[valid_idx]
  sex_clean <- sex[valid_idx]
  if (length(unique(sex_clean)) < 2) {
    return(c(statistic = NA, p_value = NA))
  }
  result <- wilcox.test(
    x_clean[sex_clean == "F"],
    x_clean[sex_clean == "M"],
    exact = FALSE
  )
  c(statistic = as.numeric(result$statistic), p_value = result$p.value)
}

wilcoxon_results <- t(apply(exprs(eset_med), 1, wilcoxon_test, sex = sex_groups))
colnames(wilcoxon_results) <- c("statistic", "p_value")

mean_male   <- apply(exprs(eset_med)[, sex_groups == "M", drop = FALSE], 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_female <- apply(exprs(eset_med)[, sex_groups == "F", drop = FALSE], 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

sex_wilcoxon_results <- data.frame(
  Name       = fData(eset_med)$Name,
  Compound.ID = fData(eset_med)$Compound.ID,
  Drug_Class = fData(eset_med)$Drug_Class,
  Wilcoxon_statistic = wilcoxon_results[, "statistic"],
  p_value    = wilcoxon_results[, "p_value"],
  Mean_Female = mean_female,
  Mean_Male   = mean_male,
  logFC       = log2(mean_male / mean_female)
) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR         = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
    Bonferroni  = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"),
    Direction   = case_when(
      logFC > 0  ~ "Higher in Males",
      logFC < 0  ~ "Higher in Females",
      TRUE       ~ "No difference"
    )
  )

cat("Sex Wilcoxon — nominal p < 0.05:", sum(sex_wilcoxon_results$p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Sex Wilcoxon — FDR < 0.05:", sum(sex_wilcoxon_results$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

sex_wilcoxon_results %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  dplyr::select(Name, Drug_Class, logFC, p_value, FDR, Bonferroni, Direction) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Sex Wilcoxon results — all medications") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

write_csv(sex_wilcoxon_results, file.path(csv_path, "newbatch2_medication_sex_wilcoxon.csv"))
```

## Trajectory Plots

Compounds nominally significant (p < 0.05) in either GW or sex limma.

```{r trajectory_plots}
traj_labels <- sex_limma_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Name, P.Value, adj.P.Val, logFC) %>%
  rename(sex_p = P.Value, sex_fdr = adj.P.Val) %>%
  left_join(
    gw_limma_results %>% dplyr::select(Name, P.Value, adj.P.Val) %>%
      rename(gw_p = P.Value, gw_fdr = adj.P.Val),
    by = "Name"
  ) %>%
  filter(sex_p < 0.05 | gw_p < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(traj_label = paste0(
    "Sex FDR=", formatC(sex_fdr, format = "e", digits = 2),
    "  logFC=", round(logFC, 3),
    "  |  GW FDR=", formatC(gw_fdr, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ))

cat("Nominally significant compounds for trajectory plots:", nrow(traj_labels), "\n")

if (nrow(traj_labels) > 0) {
  traj_plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(traj_labels)), function(i) {
    plot_trajectory(traj_labels$Name[i],
      eset         = eset_med,
      title_suffix = traj_labels$traj_label[i]
    )
  })
  save_trajectory_grids(traj_plots, "trajectories_medications", png_path, svg_path)
} else {
  cat("No nominally significant compounds — no trajectory plots produced.\n")
}
```

## Method Overlap — UpSet Plot

Overlap across GW limma, sex limma, and sex Wilcoxon at nominal p < 0.05.
FDR threshold is not used here given low N.

```{r upset_plot}
gw_nominal   <- gw_limma_results    %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05)  %>% pull(Name)
sex_lm_nom   <- sex_limma_results   %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05)  %>% pull(Name)
sex_wx_nom   <- sex_wilcoxon_results %>% filter(p_value < 0.05) %>% pull(Name)

all_hits <- unique(c(gw_nominal, sex_lm_nom, sex_wx_nom))

n_nonempty_sets <- sum(c(length(gw_nominal) > 0,
                         length(sex_lm_nom)  > 0,
                         length(sex_wx_nom)  > 0))

if (length(all_hits) > 0 && n_nonempty_sets >= 2) {
  upset_df <- data.frame(
    Name          = all_hits,
    GW_limma_nom  = as.integer(all_hits %in% gw_nominal),
    Sex_limma_nom = as.integer(all_hits %in% sex_lm_nom),
    Sex_Wilcox_nom = as.integer(all_hits %in% sex_wx_nom)
  )

  png(file.path(png_path, "upset_medications.png"),
    width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
  upset(upset_df %>% dplyr::select(-Name),
    order.by        = "freq",
    decreasing      = TRUE,
    main.bar.color  = "grey30",
    text.scale      = 1.3,
    mainbar.y.label = "Compounds in Intersection",
    sets.x.label    = "Compounds per Method"
  )
  dev.off()

  upset(upset_df %>% dplyr::select(-Name),
    order.by        = "freq",
    decreasing      = TRUE,
    main.bar.color  = "grey30",
    text.scale      = 1.3,
    mainbar.y.label = "Compounds in Intersection",
    sets.x.label    = "Compounds per Method"
  )

  write_csv(upset_df, file.path(csv_path, "newbatch2_medication_upset.csv"))
} else if (length(all_hits) > 0) {
  cat("Nominal hits found in only one method — UpSet plot requires ≥ 2 sets. Skipping.\n")
  cat("Nominal hits:", paste(all_hits, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("No nominally significant hits across any method — UpSet plot skipped.\n")
}
```
